highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.2 prevents reuse of uninitialized cached textures after failed Ganesh flushes.

bullets.detail: Drops uniquely held thread-safe cache entries after a failed Ganesh flush so subsequent draws cannot reuse textures that were never initialized. Entries still held elsewhere are not removed.

v4.153.2.headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.2 clears uniquely held Ganesh cache entries after failed flushes.
